description: Every 15 minutes on weekdays, reads new emails in the Hotmail or Outlook.com folders chosen in setup, has AI read each PDF or photo attachment, keeps the PDF as a workspace file, works out which client the bill is for, and adds one AP bill row per supplier tax invoice. Each new row starts an Enter a supplier bill job. It never changes the mailbox.
